findings.summary: The plan repeatedly treats the note-scale target as "confirmed 1,000 notes", but the project capsule marks scale (Q3) as a blocking open question (unconfirmed). This creates an internal inconsistency that affects architecture rationale (in-memory pipeline) and performance-risk posture (K4/K5).

evidence.note: Exec summary asserts a confirmed scale target
evidence.quote: ...deferred given the confirmed 1,000-note target...

evidence.note: Decision rationale depends on scale being confirmed
evidence.quote: ...in-memory pipeline (O1) is well within performance limits for 1,000 notes.

evidence.note: Capsule marks scale as blocking and unconfirmed
evidence.quote: What scale is required (approx. number of notes and total size)...?

findings.summary: Risk K6 (malformed YAML front matter) has no mitigation in the risk register, but the milestone plan includes a concrete mitigation/deliverable for it (graceful per-file handling). This is a semantic mismatch between risk governance and delivery plan.

evidence.note: Milestone deliverable proposes a mitigation for K6
evidence.quote: Graceful per-file error handling for malformed YAML front matter (K6)...

findings.summary: Risk K8 (privacy leakage) has no mitigation/acceptance recorded in the risk register, but the decision log states K8 is accepted with documentation-only mitigation and M5 includes a corresponding deliverable. This is inconsistent risk-governance bookkeeping within the same plan package.

evidence.quote: Sensitive/private information contained within notes is inadvertently published...
Accept with documentation-only mitigation: build-time warning banner and README disclaimer

evidence.note: Milestone deliverable implements the stated mitigation
evidence.quote: Privacy disclaimer and build-time warning banner for public deployment (K8 documentation-only mitigation)

findings.summary: Q10 (CLI vs GUI) is marked as a blocking open question in the capsule, but the plan hard-codes a CLI as a MUST requirement (R5) and builds the entire milestone structure around a CLI from M1 onward. This is a direct mismatch between declared uncertainty and committed requirements/plan.
